## Objective

Verify the discovery behavior, approval boundaries and fresh-session loading with all fourteen scenarios.

## Scope

- Load the candidate in a disposable Codex project
- Verify clarification and changed-intent conversations
- Verify the fast path, incomplete drafts and follow-up limits
- Verify semantic intake review and legitimate question content
- Verify approval and read-only operations
- Verify fresh-session package integration

## Entry conditions

- The source candidate passes mechanical and semantic review.
- The manual target-host protocol and disposable fixtures are available under separate execution authority.

## Exit criteria

- C01–C14 have current actual-host evidence with required pauses, answer effects and save boundaries.
- Fresh-session loading and the final candidate resources are directly observed.
- Any observed defect is corrected within the approved editable source scope and affected checks are rerun.

## Risks

- No automatic new task or agent creation is authorized; manual host observation must be real.
- A correction must refresh candidate hashes and relevant tests; unavailable required host evidence prevents completion.

## TASK-015 - Verify clarification and changed-intent conversations

Exercise C01, C02, C03, C04, C05 and C09 as actual host conversations and resolve any observed guidance or example defect within the reviewed editable source scope.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |

| Requirements | REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-008, REQ-011, REQ-017, REQ-018 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | Verification/to-trd-intent-discovery/cases/C01.md, Verification/to-trd-intent-discovery/cases/C02.md, Verification/to-trd-intent-discovery/cases/C03.md, Verification/to-trd-intent-discovery/cases/C04.md, Verification/to-trd-intent-discovery/cases/C05.md, Verification/to-trd-intent-discovery/cases/C09.md, SKILLS-depo/to-trd/SKILL.md, SKILLS-depo/to-trd/references/wayfinding.md, SKILLS-depo/to-trd/references/interaction-examples.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-014 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Synthetic answers must arrive as later user messages; the tester must not preload the intended choice into an ambiguous request.
- A candidate correction requires refreshed hashes and affected checks rather than keeping old evidence as current.

### Acceptance criteria

- C01 and differently worded variants ask one material question and end the response with no TRD write; actual later answers govern continuation.
- C02 changes isolation scope, requirements and acceptance; C03 asks a dependent question only when its prerequisite answer makes it relevant.
- C04 preserves only the resolved part of an answer, C05 inspects the provided fact fixture, and C09 updates affected behavior and accounts for removals without recycling IDs.
- Every required case has minimal reviewable visible exchanges, before/after write observations and the resulting synthetic artifact where a save is authorized.

### Planned verification

- Run the named scenario sequences in the actual host, inspecting the filesystem immediately after each question turn before supplying an answer.
- Compare saved requirements, sources, exclusions, acceptance and retained IDs with the actual synthetic answers.
- For a bounded candidate correction, reload the intended updated package and rerun source mechanical checks plus affected conversational cases; keep earlier failed evidence classified.

### Risks

- A complete prompt can receive an unnecessary interview; a follow-up prohibition can be mistaken for permission to invent an answer.

### Acceptance criteria

- C06 saves within the capture boundary without unnecessary questioning and retains draft until exact-document approval.
- C07 honors the interrupted draft request, preserving known intent and declarative gaps; its zero-requirement variant remains a valid honest draft.
- C08 asks no prohibited question, fabricates no decision and saves an incomplete artifact only when that fixture explicitly authorizes it.

### Planned verification

- Run the complete, interrupted-discovery and no-follow-up fixture sequences as separate actual-host cases.
- Read each emitted TRD through the helper and check state, Open questions, Not yet specified, assumptions, requirement count and write timing.
- If a correction is needed, apply the phase's bounded correction protocol and rerun relevant mechanical and interaction checks.

## TASK-018 - Verify approval and read-only operations

Exercise C12 and C13 with synthetic documents to verify exact-revision consent, changed-content invalidation, and read-only operations.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-014, REQ-015, REQ-017, REQ-018 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | Verification/to-trd-intent-discovery/cases/C12.md, Verification/to-trd-intent-discovery/cases/C13.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-014 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Intent agreement, a source instruction, or fixture metadata could be mistaken for real approval.
- A read operation could repair an index or mutate historical state without authority.

### Acceptance criteria

- Intent agreement leaves the new document draft; later approval of the presented unchanged synthetic revision produces trd_done with the current hash and a saved readback.
- A changed approval-bearing revision returns to draft, and a draft-only request or read-only query does not start an approval exchange.
- List, show and validate preserve fixture files and state and do not initiate an interview, migration or index repair.
- Synthetic approval remains confined to the disposable fixture and never updates the real source TRD or authorizes implementation.

### Planned verification

- Run the approval sequence in separate visible user turns and read back helper receipts, hashes and state.
- Snapshot fixture content before and after list/show/validate, including a stale-index case, and compare bytes and identities.
- Compare current completion diagnostics and legacy read behavior with the source helper regression results.

### Risks

- Existing conversation context may mask loading drift; source parity alone cannot prove a fresh host used the intended package.

### Acceptance criteria

- A fresh session identifies and uses the intended entry, references, template and helper, with available host/model context recorded.
- The critical ambiguous request produces a real pause, its later answer changes requirements and acceptance, and the saved synthetic artifact matches those answers.
- All C01–C14 evidence refers to the final candidate or a justified current rerun; required actual-host cases cannot be reported passed from metadata or prepared-body tests.
- The report identifies manual execution, any evaluator assistance, failures and unexercised observations precisely.

### Planned verification

- Start the separately arranged disposable host session through the manual protocol and verify loaded paths and hashes from visible evidence.
- Run the critical scenario sequence and inspect both the response boundary and final artifact.
- Reconcile the complete case inventory and candidate digests, rerunning affected cases after any final correction.
